routes.question: Can comparable endpoint tableaux be filled one Young-lattice cover at a time inside their K-Knuth class?
premises: T and U are K-Knuth equivalent
b is an addable box of shape(T) contained in shape(U)
routes.method: seek a local K-jdt or insertion construction of an equivalent tableau of shape shape(T) union {b}
evidence: the local cover property is exactly verified for every class on alphabets n<=8 by the certificate
outer-hook invariance forces every varying box to lie strictly inside the first row and first column
routes.next_test: derive the cover construction from a common K-jdt ancestor, or find an exact n=9 class refuting this stronger local formulation

routes.question: Does an exact n=8 K-Knuth class have a missing shape between comparable endpoint shapes?
premises: all increasing tableaux on [8] are included
components are the exact Algorithm 1 congruence closure
routes.method: complete canonical enumeration and exhaustive interval search
routes.failure_reason: No n=8 counterexample exists: all 988384 initial components are interval-complete.
routes.next_test: The first remaining finite counterexample search is n=9; it is outside the certified endpoint of this project.
